AddMemories.description_en: Adds new facts, messages, or metadata to the memory store of a user. The Add Memory endpoint accepts raw text or conversation turns and uses an asynchronous commit to commit them so that the memory is ready to search, retrieve, and run graph queries
AddMemories.description_zh: 向用户的记忆存储中添加新的事实、消息或元数据。“添加记忆”端点接受原始文本或对话回合，并异步提交它们，以便记忆准备好用于后续的搜索、检索和图查询

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a resource belongs

CreateAddonRelease.description_en: Installs an integration component to perform an integration
CreateAddonRelease.description_zh: 安装接入组件，代表进行一次接入

CreateDeliveryTask.description_en: Creates a data delivery node that delivers metric data from a specified data source to a destination storage service or MSMQ. This operation supports three delivery types: Prometheus Remote Write, Kafka, and MaxCompute. You can use labels to filter the metrics to be delivered and attach custom labels to the delivered metrics
CreateDeliveryTask.description_zh: 创建数据投递任务，将指定数据源的指标数据投递至目标存储或消息队列，支持 Prometheus Remote Write、Kafka、MaxCompute 三种投递类型。支持通过标签过滤指定投递的指标范围，以及为投递指标附加自定义标签

CreatePrometheusInstance.description_en: Creates a Managed Service for Prometheus instance

CreatePrometheusVirtualInstance.description_en: Creates a virtual instance for Prometheus monitoring

CreateServiceObservability.description_en: Creates application observability and prepares the prerequisite resources required for integration
CreateServiceObservability.description_zh: 创建应用可观测，完成接入前置资源准备等；

CreateServiceRecord.description_en: Creates a service-linked entry for associating configurations with the application monitoring service, such as log association
CreateServiceRecord.description_zh: 创建服务关联条目，用于创建应用监控服务的关联配置，例如日志关联；

CreateServiceTask.description_en: Creates a ServiceTask (heap dump or LiveDebug diagnostic task) for a specified application
CreateServiceTask.description_zh: 为指定应用创建 ServiceTask（堆转储或 LiveDebug 诊断任务）

CreateTicket.description_en: Generates a ticket for passwordless access if you need to share console pages with others without requiring logon or embed them in third-party systems. After generating the ticket by calling CreateTicket, you can construct a passwordless access link
CreateTicket.description_zh: 如果您需要将控制台页面免密分享给其他人或者嵌入到第三方系统，可以调用CreateTicket生成票据，然后拼接免密链接

DeleteMemories.description_en: Deletes memories based on filter properties. You must set at least one filter property. If no filter properties are set, a validation error is returned
DeleteMemories.description_zh: 通过过滤属性删除记忆。至少需要设置一个过滤属性，若不设置任何过滤属性，则会返回验证错误提示

DeleteNotifyPolicy.description_en: Deletes a notification policy in a specified workspace. After deletion, the policy no longer sends notifications for subscribed events
DeleteNotifyPolicy.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间下的通知策略。删除后该策略不再对订阅事件发送通知

DeletePrometheusVirtualInstance.description_en: Deletes a Prometheus virtual instance by its ID
DeletePrometheusVirtualInstance.description_zh: 通过虚拟实例 ID 删除 Prometheus 虚拟实例

DeleteServiceTask.description_en: Deletes a specified ServiceTask under a specified application
DeleteServiceTask.description_zh: 删除指定应用下的 ServiceTask

DeleteUmodelCommonSchemaRef.description_en: Deletes a public Umodel schema reference

DisableNotifyPolicy.description_en: Disables a specified notification policy. After the policy is disabled, notifications are paused but all configurations are retained. The policy can be re-enabled
DisableNotifyPolicy.description_zh: 停用指定通知策略。停用后策略暂停发送通知，但保留全部配置，可再次启用

EnableNotifyPolicy.description_en: Enables a disabled notification policy in a specified workspace. After the policy is enabled, it resumes sending notifications for subscribed events
EnableNotifyPolicy.description_zh: 启用指定工作空间下已禁用的通知策略。启用后该策略恢复对订阅事件发送通知

ExecuteQuery.description_en: Executes SQL, SPL, and other queries
ExecuteQuery.description_zh: 执行 sql、spl 等查询接口

GetAddon.description_en: Retrieves the details of an add-on

GetAddonRelease.description_en: Queries the details and accessed state of an add-on release
GetAddonRelease.description_zh: 查看addon release(查看接入状态)

GetAddonSchema.description_en: Queries the schema details of an add-on

GetCloudResourceData.description_en: Queries all entity information of a specific cloud service within a specified time range
GetCloudResourceData.description_zh: 查询指定时间内某个云产品的全部实体信息

GetCmsService.description_en: Checks whether a Prometheus service or product is activated
GetCmsService.description_zh: 检查Prometheus服务或商品开通状态

GetContextStore.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified context store

GetDataset.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified dataset

GetDeliveryTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of a data delivery task
GetDeliveryTask.description_zh: 获取数据投递任务详情

GetEntityStore.description_en: Retrieves the storage information of an EntityStore

GetEntityStoreData.description_en: Queries the entity and relationship data in a specified workspace, and returns the entity data within a specific time range
GetEntityStoreData.description_zh: 查询指定Workspace下的实体和关系数据，返回结果显示某时间区间中的实体数据

GetIntegrationPolicy.description_zh: 查询接入中心策略信息

GetIntegrationVersionForCS.description_en: Queries the Integration Center version for a container cluster
GetIntegrationVersionForCS.description_zh: 查询容器集群链接的接入中心版本

GetNotifyPolicy.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified notification policy

GetPrometheusInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a specified Managed Service for Prometheus instance
GetPrometheusInstance.description_zh: 查询指定Prometheus实例详情信息

GetPrometheusUserSetting.description_en: Retrieves the user settings for Prometheus

GetPrometheusView.description_en: Queries the details of a specified Prometheus view instance
GetPrometheusView.description_zh: 查询指定Prometheus视图实例详情

GetServiceTask.description_en: Queries the details of a single ServiceTask under a specified application
GetServiceTask.description_zh: 查询指定应用下单个 ServiceTask 的详情

GetUmodelCommonSchemaRef.description_en: Retrieves the referenced public Umodel schema

GetUmodelData.description_en: Retrieves graph data associated with a Umodel
GetUmodelData.description_zh: 获取相关联的 Umodel 图数据

ListAddons.description_en: Queries the grouped product list of the new integration center
ListAddons.description_zh: 新版接入中心产品列表(分组)

ListAggTaskGroups.description_en: Queries the list of aggregation task groups

ListAlertHistories.description_zh: 分页查询云监控2.0告警历史记录列表

ListBizTraces.description_en: Queries the list of business links

ListContextStoreAPIKeys.description_en: Retrieves a list of API keys
ListContextStoreAPIKeys.description_zh: 获取 API Key 列表

ListContextStores.description_en: Queries the list of context stores

ListDeliveryTasks.description_en: Retrieves a list of data delivery tasks
ListDeliveryTasks.description_zh: 获取数据投递任务列表

ListIntegrationPolicies.description_en: Queries the list of integration center policies
ListIntegrationPolicies.description_zh: 查询接入中心策略列表信息

ListIntegrationPolicyAddons.description_en: Retrieves the list of add-ons installed for the current policy
ListIntegrationPolicyAddons.description_zh: 获取当前策略安装的Addon列表

ListIntegrationPolicyCollectors.description_en: Returns information about collectors for an Integration Center policy
ListIntegrationPolicyCollectors.description_zh: 获取接入中心策略的采集器信息

ListIntegrationPolicyCustomScrapeJobRule.description_en: Retrieves the custom service discovery rules of a Provisioning policy
ListIntegrationPolicyCustomScrapeJobRule.description_zh: 获取接入中心策略的自定义服务发现规则

ListIntegrationPolicyPodMonitors.description_en: Retrieves the PodMonitor resources of an Integration Center policy
ListIntegrationPolicyPodMonitors.description_zh: 获取接入中心策略的PodMonitor资源

ListIntegrationPolicyServiceMonitors.description_en: Retrieves the ServiceMonitor information of a Provisioning policy
ListIntegrationPolicyServiceMonitors.description_zh: 获取接入中心策略的ServiceMonitor信息

ListIntegrationPolicyStorageRequirements.description_en: Lists the storage requirements for an Integration Center policy
ListIntegrationPolicyStorageRequirements.description_zh: 获取接入中心策略的存储要求信息

ListMaintainWindows.description_en: Queries a list of silence policies

ListMemoryStores.description_en: Queries the list of memory stores

ListOncallContacts.description_en: Queries the on-call contacts at a specified time
ListOncallContacts.description_zh: 查询某个时间的值班人

ListPrometheusDashboards.description_en: Retrieves the list of dashboards for a Managed Service for Prometheus instance

ListPrometheusInstances.description_en: Retrieves a list of Managed Service for Prometheus instances

ListPrometheusViews.description_en: Queries a list of Prometheus view instances
ListPrometheusViews.description_zh: 获取Prometheus视图实例信息列表

ListServiceRecords.description_zh: 列表查询服务关联条目

ListServices.description_en: Queries application observability services in batches
ListServices.description_zh: 批量查询应用可观测服务

ListUserNotifyHistories.description_en: Queries the alert notification delivery history in a specified workspace by using paging, and supports filtering by conditions such as notification channel, alert severity, subscription, alert rule, recipient, delivery result, and time range
ListUserNotifyHistories.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间下的告警通知发送历史记录，支持按通知渠道、告警级别、订阅、告警规则、接收人、发送结果、时间范围等条件筛选

OpenCmsService.description_en: Activates CloudMonitor services, including Hybrid Cloud Monitoring, Managed Service for Prometheus, and Simple Log Service (SLS)
OpenCmsService.description_zh: 开通云监控服务，包括企业云监控、Prometheus服务、SLS日志服务

PreviewNotifyTemplate.description_en: Renders templates written in Go template syntax by using the provided context data and returns the rendering results. This operation supports the simultaneous preview of multiple templates, such as title and content, to enable real-time preview in frontend template editors
PreviewNotifyTemplate.description_zh: 传入 Go template 语法的模板内容和渲染上下文数据，返回各模板的渲染结果。支持同时预览多个模板（如 title 和 content），用于前端模板编辑器的实时预览能力

SearchMemories.description_en: Searches for memories based on query conditions and filters
SearchMemories.description_zh: 根据查询条件和筛选项来搜索记忆

UpdateAggTaskGroupStatus.description_en: Updates the status of an aggregation task group

UpdateContextStore.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a context store

UpdatePrometheusInstance.description_en: Updates the information of a Managed Service for Prometheus instance

UpdatePrometheusUserSetting.description_en: Updates the user settings for Prometheus. Note: If you set `settingKey` to `financeUsageRegion`, Prometheus usage data is sent to Simple Log Service (SLS) in the specified region. Historical usage data will no longer be available in the Prometheus console
UpdatePrometheusUserSetting.description_zh:
更新Prometheus用户配置信息。
注意：修改settingKey=financeUsageRegion，会将Prometheus用量数据切换到指定region的sls，同时历史用量数据将无法在Prometheus控制台查看

UpdatePrometheusView.description_en: Updates the information of a Prometheus view instance

UpdateUmodel.description_en: Updates the configuration of a Umodel

UpsertUmodelCommonSchemaRef.description_en: Upserts a common Umodel schema reference

ViewOncallSchedule.description_en: Queries the on-call calendar of a specified on-call schedule within a given date range, and returns the contacts and start and end times of each on-call shift grouped by shift name
ViewOncallSchedule.description_zh: 查看指定值班表在给定日期范围内的排班日历，按班次名称分组返回各值班时段的联系人与起止时间

endpoints.region_name_zh: 华北6（乌兰察布）通用行业云
